set.body: On the V2 fixture candidate, implement standalone eyes4s and pinned pymovements ASC adapters that materialize the entire binocular sample table with time_us, eye, x_px, y_px, pupil and status. Normalize the native zero-pupil gap marker to explicit lost/null canonical rows while retaining a native artifact, and validate parsed message/eye metadata. Prove byte-identical canonical output and expected counts on small/typical/large. This is correctness preflight only, not a timed performance claim or full PM3.4 collector.
set.title: PM3.4b Canonical binocular ASC adapters and parity probe
